maya: Quick heads-up — we need 2x LGTM on PR #8342 (kv-cache warmup tweak) before the 18:00 PT cutover or we fallback to previous image. https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/PR/8342 :hourglass: 
sam: On it, pinged a couple reviewers. @juan can you eyeball the perf delta? I ran the smoke tests locally, looks fine but want a second opinion. :eyes:
juan: I can take a look in ~20m (in meetings until 16:10 PT). if it's small we can approve and sam can merge during the window.
li: saw a flake in ci earlier but looks unrelated (timeout on integration test). Re-ran the job: `./ci/run_smoke.sh --filter=kv_warmup` passed for me.
maya: thanks li — if CI stays green we still need one more LGTM. @ashley are you available to give the second sign-off after juan?
ashley: I can jump on this at 16:30 PT. If anyone finds a regression call it out. If not, I'll add LGTM and sam can proceed. :thumbsup:
sam: FYI merging instructions: `git checkout main && git pull && ./scripts/merge-and-tag.sh pr/8342` — I'll be online to run it at 17:50 PT in case we need to hold till the last minute.
maya: fallback plan if we don't get 2x by cutoff: hold the cutover and run a small canary with previous image, then schedule a hotfix window tomorrow morning. I prefer we avoid that but call it out.
juan: quick note on perf numbers — median tail latency unchanged, token throughput +3% on my local 8k run. nothing alarming.
ashley: looked at diff: only touches kv cache warmup path and adds a guard. code lgtm pending green CI.
ops-bot: CI pipeline #8342-build passed (15:37 PT). smoke-tests: passed. deploy-staging: queued.
sam: ok, I'll wait for juan confirmation then merge at 17:50 PT unless we hear blockers.
maya: thanks all — please react with :eyes: when you’ve actually reviewed so I can track.
juan: :eyes:
li: :thumbsup:
ashley: :thumbsup: 
maya: merging window 17:50 PT — sam pls shout if anything odd.
